description: This PHP source file defines the Supervisor class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically as part of the reporting display fields for supervisors. The class extends ListableDisplayField and provides specific configurations such as the DTO class, display fields, and entity aliases related to supervisor reporting.

classes.name: Supervisor
classes.description: Represents a report display field for supervisors, extending ListableDisplayField and specifying DTO, fields, and aliases.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of fields (e.g., database columns) to be displayed or retrieved for the supervisor report.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of aliases used in database queries for the supervisor entity.
